Team — attaching the draft slide pack (Q3_board_storyline_v2.pptx) and the OKR signal matrix. Goal: lock the top-line narrative and three priority asks to present to Founders Capital next week. Please read with the following constraints in mind:

- We have 8 slides for the board proper, three supporting deep-dive appendices. Keep the opener focused on product performance vs. cost (we need that headline).
- OKR signals: call out both progress (green) and risk/mitigations (amber) — avoid long technical detail on the main slides.
- Tone: confident on reliability gains, candid on model-efficiency gaps and the ask (additional committed capacity + runway for a private deployment pilot).

Action items:
1) Neha — refine the risk bullets on slide 4 and consolidate the SOC/Compliance callouts into one appendix slide.
2) Tessa — tighten the customer story and the single pull-quote; swap the quote if we can get legal OK.
3) Laura — finalize the financial slide numbers and confirm the CPU/GPU cost delta figure (we need a single percent).
4) Marissa — one-line synopsis for the exec summary and a 2-sentence recommended ask for Founders Capital.

Please reply with "ACK + small note" or send edits by EOD. I want to freeze narrative by 3pm PT today so I can route to Maya for pre-read by COB.

Thanks —
